The Semaphore (Telegraph Hill Dwellers), no. 215, September 2016
sources.label: San Francisco neighborhood newspapers collection (Internet Archive)

historical_record.description: The oldest house on Napier Lane, formerly Billings Place, a board-frame cottage of 1857 first the home of Mortimer and John Clark, a teamster and a laborer at the Greenwich Dock Warehouse. Its Italianate false front likely dates from about 1887, but the outline and roof of the 1857 cottage remain. One of the Telegraph Hill houses that came through the 1906 fire.

unknowns: The Semaphore, drawing on the Telegraph Hill Historic District's research, dates the building at 10 Napier to 1857; the assessor's roll says 1900.
